We present $N$-body simulations of a torus in the field of a supermassive black hole (SMBH), made of up to $N=10^5$ gravitationally interacting clouds.
We have developed the dynamical model of a clumpy torus in an active galactic nucleus (AGN) and compared to recent ALMA observations.

In this paper we develop a dynamical model of an obscuring clumpy torus in AGNs with the purpose of interpreting the ALMA velocity and velocity dispersion maps together with the temperature distribution.
